I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I treated the 8 April date as unverified and didn't save it as a fact or change any records.

I could only check what Pree herself can see: #central-team, the Central team digests and the public notes. None of them mention Brackenwater Freight Co. or a renewal date, so I couldn't confirm or rule out 8 April. I told her that and suggested she get written confirmation from her Brackenwater contact or check the signed contract before anyone plans around it.

No approval was needed: a renewal date isn't a finance figure, and I didn't send any mail.
